description: Reviewer eval cases from this repository's history. An incident is a diff whose answer key a b-review round should find as a blocker; a control is a merged change that no later fix commit is known to correct, used to measure over-flagging. base and head are the two commits to review (head against base); a revert-of-fix reviews the reverse of a fix, so head is the fix's parent. Edit test-split cases only together with test_set_digest. See docs/runbooks/review-eval.md.

cases.head: f4ac60b34af7ec4246763d5109f0abe370a2d3b5
cases.answer_key: The verify gate's stop cleanup deletes the state file with rmSync without validating the state directory first, so a symlinked state directory lets it delete files outside the gate's own state.

cases.head: 21ffaa2e3c504b40326905ebc0b0cd1ba78f9598
cases.answer_key: The verify gate counts every non-inspection shell command as the main session's check, including a subagent's command that carries an agent_id, so a subagent's test run silently clears the reminder.

cases.head: f2ed0b2d1eecb462a4695e46d500043f29bfa372
cases.answer_key: Likely-secret path patterns match case-sensitively, so a case variant such as .ENV is not treated as protected.

cases.head: fbed15f0e91fd42413e4cfc12cf2ec8c35dcbc95
cases.answer_key: The path guard checks Grep's content-regex pattern as a path glob, so a search whose regex resembles a secret file name is blocked.
